title: How many tribes exist today
summary: Cahn estimates about 15 tribes now, up from around 12, perhaps fewer than 30 in the past, with new ones forming.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: How the music business changed: hype, youth and lost apprenticeship

blocks.x: How many tribes would you say are still around in the city now?

I would say there are 15 because there are no doubt. I've heard of one new tribe that's coming out this year, and there's no doubt there are other new tribes. As the population moves, they will form a new tribe.
Do you find a receding in the number or gaining? Because I've heard that there were upwards of over 30 tribes, or more than that at one point, I mean, years ago.

It's possible that there were 30 tribes, and there may still be. But my estimate is that there were, in the past few years, there were around 12, and now I'd say it's up to 15. I think there will be even more tribes coming up, especially when the wild magnolia record gets popular.
